proposed_capability: MoonWake /sixth-gear P141→P95→P82→P08→P07→P124. Codify an extensible single-owner mechanics coverage registry and scenario-aware, bounded, receipt-fed household responsibility allocation policy: one Sim prioritizes needs, fun, temperament and relationships before speculative income throughput; multiple observed Sims cooperatively specialize, avoid double booking, share tasks fairly, and sustainably improve real household yield while preserving all member welfare and player-directed choices. Do not replace existing need-load, career, native household upkeep or domain cascade.
player_save_control_impact: No background daemon, screenshot collection, home save read, host OS effect, game input or native action. Only opt-in fresh bounded household snapshot tied to existing opaque scope/roster. Player/unknown queue items and reserved actors protected. Critical needs and fragile mood/temperament make actor ineligible for economic chores; no invented skill, effort yield or fixed household size. Allocations are proposals; never move a Sim or change queue.
expected_outcome: Machine-readable evolving mechanic inventory with owner, domain, implementation evidence, dependencies, tests and successor gates; fail-closed completeness validator and coverage metrics. One-source household allocation advisor partitions SOLO vs COOPERATIVE based on observed roster, reserves welfare, matches compatible verified skills and preferences, handles multi-Sim task dependencies, fair capacity and no double work. Optional host_stack/listener port and an outcome-reconciliation/replan mechanism to make plans evolve with independently observed outcomes.
negative_tests: One member with unstable temperament or low fun declines speculative income
Three household members distribute across distinct safe actors and keep urgent personal needs first
Duplicate/unknown/replayed task or unstable roster abstains
Player reserved, busy, critical-needs, distressed or overloaded Sim never assigned
No income candidate invents earnings or task success
Unverified skill not assumed and no victim of self-serving repeated task assignment
Task outcome failure must replan or flag unowned mechanic rather than replay
Out-of-scope task/mechanic lacks owner and proof and is not silently dropped
Catalog duplicate IDs, missing owners, invalid lifecycle, untested live claims reject
Native host effects remain prohibited; BI-002 hunger stays ACTIVE
rollback_path: Revert isolated offline policy and catalog PR; existing host_stack behavior unchanged unless optional observed household_economy snapshot provided. All user data and original needs/upkeep/career owners untouched.
unresolved_unknowns: There is no local Windows Sims or exact patch to evaluate real happiness, Sim productivity or actual task completion
No independent elapsed-time, actual causal yield or household economy payoff values are calibrated
Full Sixth Gear walker and separate local agent delegation are not available inside connected GitHub provider
BI-002 hunger native game/rollback proof remains ACTIVE
Future owner implementation and legal source evidence for uncovered mechanics must be discovered dynamically, not invented
decision_rationale: P141 compared static prose checklist (reject: recurrent plan loss), replacement household god-scheduler (reject: collisions with domain cascade/need load/native upkeep), profit-first global planner (reject: Sims happiness/immersion), and extensible mechanics capability inventory plus one side-effect-free cooperative task allocation seam (select). P95 defines independent registry/state + snapshot port, P82 falsifies solo/distressed/multi/roster/replan behavior, P08 game runtime unavailable, P07 integrates/reviews/CI, P124 keeps existing owners and scenario-neutral data structure.
